import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        int n = s.length();
        boolean firstAt = true;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
            if (i + 1 < n && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                if (i == 0) {
                    System.out.print("at");
                    i += 2;
                } else if (i == n - 2) {
                    System.out.print("at");
                    break;
                } else if (firstAt) {
                    System.out.print("@");
                    firstAt = false;
                    i += 2;
                } else {
                    System.out.print('a');
                    ++i;
                }
            } else if (i + 2 < n && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                if (i == 0) {
                    System.out.print("dot");
                    i += 3;
                } else if (i == n - 3) {
                    System.out.print("dot");
                    break;
                } else {
                    System.out.print(".");
                    i += 3;
                }
            } else {
                System.out.print(s.charAt(i));
                ++i;
            }
        }

        scanner.close();
    }
}
